Solara — (9.2) NEBULA

CREW OF MENACE

"Crew of menace"

[Intro — narrator, dry and calm]

Let the record show

That SOLARA’s crew had a combined bounty

Of three hundred and fifteen thousand star coins

(impressive)

And somewhere on the other side of the fold

Was a crew

Whose captain alone

Had a bounty of one billion

(one)(billion)

Let the record also show

That nobody warned her

[Verse 1]

His name was Chaos

And Chaos needed a crew

Not because he asked for one

But because things kept happening around him

And someone needed to write them down

[Pre-Chorus]

Three constellations who heard the word destruction

And said: yes — that is my word

Chaos looked at them: what are your names

The first one said: Havoc

The second one said: Ruin

The third had already broken something

(he was named Mayhem)(retroactively)

[Chorus]

Crew of menace

They did not apply

They did not interview

They simply arrived and started destroying things

And Chaos said: perfect

These are exactly the right kind of wrong people

Crew of menace

Havoc and Ruin and Mayhem

Three different words for the same excellent idea

And Chaos at the center

Worth one billion star coins

And climbing

[Verse 2]

But a crew needs records

Chaos needed someone to take notes

He looked around

Spida and Catipala were there

(why)(unclear)(they were not sure either)

(they had followed the sound of destruction)(out of curiosity)

(they were regretting this)

Chaos said: you two — take notes

Spida said: we are gatekeepers we do not take notes

Chaos looked at them (he did not blink)(for a long time)

Spida said: we will take notes

Catipala already had a quill

(where did he get a quill)(he always has a quill)(why)(nobody knows)

[Bridge — Chaos finds the bounty list]

Chaos found a copy of the bounty board

He read it

(one hundred thousand)(for SOLARA)

He read it again

(one hundred thousand)

He looked at his own number

One billion

He looked at SOLARA’s number again

(one hundred thousand)

(she does not even know I exist yet)

(this is personally insulting)

(Spida write this down)

(Spida wrote: boss upset about math)

(that is not what I said)

(Catipala drew a picture)(it was not helpful)(Chaos kept it)

[Final Chorus]

Crew of menace

One billion reasons to be exactly where he is going

Havoc and Ruin and Mayhem

Moving through the fold

Like something the universe has not learned to name yet

And somewhere ahead of them

A captain worth one hundred thousand

Does not know yet

That the thing coming toward her

Is worth ten thousand times that

[Outro]

Havoc said: are we going to level seventy-nine

Chaos said: we are going wherever she is going

Mayhem already left (Ruin followed)(of course)

(Spida wrote: everyone left, unclear direction)

(Catipala drew a picture of a door)

(it was actually quite good)(Chaos kept it)
